verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents event-triggered automation: incident workflows that post a todo list and route incidents to the right responder when a new incident fires, PRs with suggested fixes generated from exceptions, automated post-mortems, and escalation policies that keep alerting until someone acknowledges. However, there is no evidence of a general facility for users to define their own autonomous background agent automations, and the AI SRE explicitly 'never takes any automated actions without your approval', which limits autonomy. Missing for 10: user-configurable agentic automation builder (custom triggers/schedules/actions), autonomous execution of remediation without approval, depth documentation on workflow automation, independent/hands-on corroboration.
